officials.name: Commissionerate of Agriculture, Maharashtra
officials.notes: State agriculture headquarters (Central Building, Pune). Oversees District Agriculture Officers (DAO), Krishi Seva Kendra licenses, and MahaDBT subsidy distribution.

officials.name: District Agriculture Officer (DAO) — Nashik & Western MH
officials.notes: District office for crop loss assessment, onion & grape advisory, fertilizer quality testing, and PMFBY insurance claims.

officials.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) — Nashik / Yashwantrao Chavan
officials.notes: ICAR farm science centre: soil health testing, grape/onion disease diagnostics, certified seed distribution, and weather advisories.

officials.name: District Agriculture Officer (DAO) — Pune
officials.notes: District officer for vegetable farming, sugarcane agronomy, polyhouse grants, and cold storage subsidies.

officials.name: Maharashtra State Agriculture Toll-free Helpline
officials.notes: Dedicated state toll-free helpline in Marathi and Hindi for crop disease guidance, MahaDBT schemes, and seasonal alerts.

officials.name: Directorate of Agriculture, Uttar Pradesh
officials.notes: State headquarters (Krishi Bhawan, Lucknow). Oversees DBT registration, free boring schemes, and seed subsidy allotments.

officials.name: District Agriculture Officer (DAO) — Varanasi & Purvanchal
officials.notes: District officer for paddy, wheat, vegetable clusters, solar tubewells, and organic farming clusters.

officials.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) — Varanasi (ICAR-IIVR)
officials.notes: Specialist centre for vegetable crop diseases, high-yield seeds, soil testing, and spray schedule consultation.

officials.name: UP Kisan Call & DBT Advisory Helpline
officials.notes: Official UP farmer helpline in Hindi for seed subsidy, DBT status, and tubewell boring assistance.

officials.name: Farmer Welfare & Agriculture Development, Madhya Pradesh
officials.notes: State department (Vindhyachal Bhawan, Bhopal). Manages Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan, Bhavantar, and E-Krishi Yantra lottery.

officials.name: Deputy Director of Agriculture (DDA) — Indore & Malwa
officials.notes: Malwa region office for soybean harvest, wheat/chana Rabi sowing, seed testing, and custom hiring machinery.

officials.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) — Indore
officials.notes: ICAR centre specializing in soybean yellow mosaic virus management, bio-fertilizers, and water conservation.

officials.name: Commissionerate of Agriculture, Rajasthan
officials.notes: State headquarters (Pant Krishi Bhawan, Jaipur). Oversees RajKisan Sathi portal, Tarbandi, diggi subsidies, and solar pumps.

officials.name: Joint Director of Agriculture (JDA) — Jaipur & Shekhawati
officials.notes: District office for mustard, gram, bajra cultivation, drip irrigation layout approval, and field fencing sanctions.

officials.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) — Durgapura, Jaipur
officials.notes: Soil & water salinity testing, arid zone horticulture advisory, certified bajra/mustard seed distribution.

officials.name: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Punjab
officials.notes: State agriculture headquarters (Kheti Bhawan, Mohali). Oversees crop residue management (CRM), wheat/paddy seed subsidy.

officials.name: Chief Agriculture Officer (CAO) — Ludhiana
officials.notes: District head for Super Seeder subsidies, canal water roster, fertilizer regulation, and pesticide quality checks.

officials.name: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Farmer Helpline
officials.notes: Direct extension advice from PAU scientists on pest scouting, wheat varieties (HD 3086, DBW 187, PBW 824), and weed management.

officials.name: Department of Agriculture, Bihar
officials.notes: State headquarters (Vikas Bhawan, Patna). Administers Diesel Anudan, Krishi Input Subsidy, and Zero-Premium Fasal Sahayata.

officials.name: District Agriculture Officer (DAO) — Patna
officials.notes: District office for flood/drought input compensation, PACS registration, seed distribution, and soil health cards.

officials.name: Directorate of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Haryana
officials.notes: State headquarters (Krishi Bhawan, Panchkula). Oversees Meri Fasal Mera Byora, Bhavantar Bharpayee, and solar pumps.

officials.name: Kisan Call Centre (KCC) — National Agriculture Helpline
officials.notes: Toll-free national helpline. Talk directly to agricultural graduates in 22 official Indian languages including Hindi, Marathi, Punjabi, Gujarati, and Malayalam.

officials.name: PM-KISAN National Helpdesk & DBT Grievance
officials.notes: Central helpline for PM-KISAN installment issues, Aadhaar unlinking errors, eKYC status, and land record verification.

officials.name: National Crop Insurance Helpline (PMFBY)
officials.notes: Central toll-free number to report localized crop loss (inundation, storm, hailstorm) within 72 hours for prompt insurance claim processing.

officials.name: ICAR Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) National Network
officials.notes: Network of 731+ district farm-science centres across every district in India for disease testing, soil diagnosis, and high-yield seeds.

disclaimer: All helpline numbers and contacts are verified official government sources. For immediate field issues, contact your local KVK or call toll-free 1800-180-1551.
